result.title: TeamFlowRL: Online Policy Optimization of Decentralized Flow Policies for Multi-Agent Coordination
result.comment: 27 pages. Project page: https://teamflowrl.github.io/ Code: https://github.com/teamflowrl/TeamFlowRL Models: https://huggingface.co/teamflowrl/TeamFlowRL
result.summary: Complex cooperative tasks require coordinated multi-agent behavior. Offline generative policies learn expressive cooperative behaviors from trajectories but remain limited by fixed datasets. Online reinforcement learning can improve them through environment interaction. However, fine-tuning flow policies is difficult because action likelihoods are hard to compute. We propose TeamFlowRL, a two-stage framework that pretrains multi-agent flow policies offline and fine-tunes them online. We formulate team policy optimization over the complete denoising trajectories of decentralized flow policies, avoiding intractable action likelihoods. The resulting objective weights each agent's trajectory ratio with a shared team advantage and clips each ratio separately, aligning local policy updates with the common team return. Across 51 paired configurations in seven simulation groups, TeamFlowRL improves every offline initialization, with a 47.3% average gain in normalized score. It also achieves 33.1% higher average success under exploration noise than Gaussian-policy fine-tuning across 6 bimanual tasks.

AI.brief_summary: 提出两阶段框架 TeamFlowRL：先离线预训练去中心化的多智能体 flow 策略，再在完整去噪轨迹层面构造策略优化目标，用共享团队优势加权各智能体的轨迹比例并分别裁剪，从而绕开难以计算的动作似然；在七组仿真、51 个配对配置上均有提升，双臂任务中探索噪声下成功率高于高斯策略微调。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「在整条去噪轨迹上做免似然的比例优化并以共享优势加权各智能体」可能为 latent 推理轨迹的训练监督与跨步骤贡献分配提供线索，但论文本身属多智能体机器人控制，与视觉推理仅在方法层面相关，可供核查。
